title: 2025年6月四级真题 第3套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
passage:
P1 Plant-based meats are coming soon to a dinner table near you, but do they deserve a spot on your plate? If you tried a vegetable burger years ago and dismissed it as rubbery and flavorless, it's a good time to give meatless meat another chance. Newer varieties imitate the look, flavor, and texture of meat. Analysts don't expect the meat-free movement to slow anytime soon; a 2021 report predicts the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge.

P2 Plant-based meats are no longer just for vegetarians. Companies such as Impossible Foods and Beyond Meat—the current superstars of the alternative protein sector—are pursuing consumers who enjoy meat but want to reduce their meat consumption for animal rights, health, or environmental reasons. So far, it's a winning strategy: More than nine out of ten consumers who buy Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products also eat meat.

P3 Many vegetarians don't actually care for food that resembles meat. When reporter Joan Solsman, a longtime vegetarian, tried a dish from Impossible Foods, she felt so sick that she couldn't finish it. "Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn't stand to take another bite," she wrote.

P4 Meatless meats are generally a healthier choice than beef because they are cholesterol-free, plus they're a good source of vitamins, minerals, protein, and fiber.

P5 If meatless meat can help you stick to a plant-based diet, that in itself can lead to better health. Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, lower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels.

P6 However, just because it's plant-based doesn't mean it's health food. Most imitation meats are highly processed and contain high amounts of sodium(钠) compared to traditional beef.

P7 These new generations of alternate meat get all the attention, but don't forget about whole grains and vegetables. Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute. They're nutritious, inexpensive, and far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes on the market today.

questions.q: What can we expect of plant-based meats?
options: An increasing interest in their analyses.
An enormous effort in their promotion.
A huge boost in their consumption.
A noticeable surge in their varieties.
questions.explain:
【判型】What can we expect of plant-based meats? 没有出现 infer/imply/suggest，问的是一 个文中已表述的预期结果，属于事实细节题。 51. What can we expect of plant-based meats? A) An increasing interest in their analyses. B) An enormous effort in their promotion. C) A huge boost in their consumption. D) A noticeable surge in their varieties.

【拆句】What can we expect of plant-based meats? 结构是 expect sth of sb/sth（对……抱有什 么期待/预期），of 后接被期待的对象。考生熟悉的 expect sth from sb 在此处换成 of， 含义相近，不必紧张。

【定位】Analysts don't expect the meat-free movement to slow anytime soon; a 2021 report predicts the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge. 分析师们不预期植物肉浪潮短期内会放缓；一份 2021 年的报告预测，到 2030 年该市场将 猛增至 740 亿美元——增幅高达 957%。

【选项】A) 偷换概念 An increasing interest in their analyses 把原文里「分析师们的预期」偷换成「对它们 分析的兴趣增长」，文章并未说人们对植物肉的分析研究兴趣上升。 B) 无中生有 An enormous effort in their promotion 谈的是「推广上的巨大努力」，原文只说市 场规模会增长，没提企业或政府投入推广，属无中生有。 C) ✓ 正确 the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge ↔ A huge boost in their consumption 预判要的是「消费规模大增」，A huge boost in their consumption 正是这个语义， 锁定 C。 D) 偷换概念 A noticeable surge in their varieties 把 surge 的对象从原文的「市场规模」换成「种 类」，原文仅提到 Newer varieties imitate the look, flavor, and texture of meat，说 新品种已出现，但没说种类会激增。 关于购买Beyond Burger和Impossible Foods产品的消费者,我们了解到什么? A) 他们大多不是素食者。 B) 他们大多是动物权利倡导者。 C) 他们中的大多数出于健康原因不吃肉。 D) 他们中的大多数吃无肉肉类是为了保护环境。

questions.q: What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products?
options: They are mostly non-vegetarians.
They are mostly animal-rights advocates.
Most of them refrain from eating meat for health reasons.
Most of them eat meatless meat to protect the environment.
questions.explain:
【判型】What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products? 是 learn about + 名词结构，问关于该人群在原文中已写明的属性。

【拆句】What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products? 主干 What do we learn about consumers，buying ... 是后置的现在分词短语 作 consumers 的定语，相当于 who buy ...，结构无陷阱。 52. What do we learn about consumers buying Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products? A) They are mostly non-vegetarians. B) They are mostly animal-rights advocates. C) Most of them refrain from eating meat for health reasons. D) Most of them eat meatless meat to protect the environment.

【定位】More than nine out of ten consumers who buy Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products also eat meat. 在购买 Beyond Burger 和 Impossible Foods 产品的消费者中，有超过十分之九的人同时 也吃肉。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 More than nine out of ten consumers who buy Beyond Burger and Impossible Foods products also eat meat ↔They are mostly non-vegetarians 预判说的「多数也吃肉」正对应「多数非素食者」，A 命中。 B) 以偏概全 They are mostly animal-rights advocates 把动物权利说成消费者的主要身份，但原文 animal rights, health, or environmental reasons 是并列的三类动机之一，没有说大多 数是动物权利倡导者。 C) 以偏概全 Most of them refrain from eating meat for health reasons 同样把并列三动机里的 「健康」拎出来说大多数，且 refrain from eating meat（克制吃肉）与原文 reduce their meat consumption 程度被夸大。 D) 以偏概全 Most of them eat meatless meat to protect the environment 同样犯「三选一拎为 主因」的错误，无原文比例支撑。 从Joan Solsman的评论中,我们可以对Impossible Foods的产品得出什么结论? A) 它们更常吸引肉食者。 B) 它们非常像动物肉。 C) 有些已成为其招牌菜。 D) 它们大多作为真正的假肉出售。

questions.q: What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark?
options: They more often appeal to meat-eaters.
They very much resemble animal meat.
Some have become its signature dishes.
Most of them are sold as true fake meat.
questions.explain:
【判型】What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark? 中 conclude from ... remark 表示要从她的话里推出关于产品的判断。

【拆句】What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark? 主干 What can we conclude about X from Y，about 引出推断对象（产品）， from 引出推断依据（她的话）；这是固定结构。 53. What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark? A) They more often appeal to meat-eaters. B) They very much resemble animal meat. C) Some have become its signature dishes. D) Most of them are sold as true fake meat.

【定位】Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn't stand to take another bite. 或许 Impossible Foods 成功破解「逼真假肉」密码的最有力信号，就是连我（这个素食 者）都没法再吃一口。

【选项】A) 答非所问 题目要求从她的话推断 Impossible Foods 的「产品本身」特性，They more often appeal to meat-eaters 说的是「产品更受肉食者欢迎」，那是 Q52 答案，不是 Q53 的推断方向。 B) ✓ 正确 Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat ↔ They very much resemble animal meat 预判要的是「产品逼真像真肉」，They very much resemble animal meat 直接对应， 锁 B。 C) 无中生有 Some have become its signature dishes 说这些菜成了「招牌菜」，原文只说她试吃 了 a dish from Impossible Foods，并未说哪些是招牌。 D) 偷换概念 Most of them are sold as true fake meat 把 realistic fake meat（逼真的假肉）改成 sold as true fake meat（作为「真假肉」出售），不仅商业化（销售行为）是原文没有 的，true 修饰 fake meat 的逻辑也与「产品像真肉」相违。 为什么植物基饮食习惯能带来更好的健康? A) 它使人们摆脱任何已知的癌症关联。 B) 它提供保持健康所需的全部营养。 C) 它有助于维持正常的血压和血糖。 D) 它降低肉类消费带来的各种健康风险。

questions.q: Why can the habit of eating a plant-based diet lead to better health?
options: It frees people from any known link to cancer.
It provides all the nutrients for staying healthy.
It helps maintain normal blood pressure and blood sugar.
It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.
questions.explain:
【判型】Why can the habit of eating a plant-based diet lead to better health? 用 Why 提问， 原文有明确因果链时仍属细节题。

【拆句】Why can the habit of eating a plant-based diet lead to better health? 中主语是 the habit of doing sth（做某事的习惯）这个抽象名词短语，谓语 lead to 表示导致，结构平 铺直叙，无陷阱。 54. Why can the habit of eating a plant-based diet lead to better health? A) It frees people from any known link to cancer. B) It provides all the nutrients for staying healthy. C) It helps maintain normal blood pressure and blood sugar. D) It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.

【定位】Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, lower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels. 不仅红肉被发现与癌症相关，研究还显示放弃吃肉的人血压更低、平均血糖更低、胆固醇水 平也更低。

【选项】A) 过度推断 It frees people from any known link to cancer 中 frees ... from any known link 表 示「完全免除任何已知关联」，但原文只说红肉与癌症「被发现相关」（red meat been linked to cancer），并未说弃肉就能彻底斩断所有癌症关联。 B) 过度推断 It provides all the nutrients for staying healthy 说植物饮食提供「所有保持健康所需 的营养」，P4 只列了维生素、矿物质、蛋白质、纤维四项，没说「全部」。 C) 以偏概全 It helps maintain normal blood pressure and blood sugar 只提血压和血糖，漏了胆 固醇和癌症，且 maintain normal 意为「维持正常」，比 lower 表达的「降低」程度 还弱。 D) ✓ 正确 Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, lower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels. ↔It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption 预判要「综合性下降」，D 的 various health risks 正好覆盖了四种风险，是唯一概 括项。 作者在文章结尾建议我们吃什么? A) 天然生产的食物。 B) 加工蛋白质替代品。 C) 传统牛肉之类的红肉。 D) 新一代替代肉类。

questions.q: What does the author recommend we eat at the end of the passage?
options: Naturally produced foods.
Processed protein substitutes.
Red meats like traditional beef.
New generations of alternate meat.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author recommend we eat at the end of the passage? 位置写死、动作 写死，只问被推荐的事物，不涉及推断。

【拆句】What does the author recommend we eat at the end of the passage? 中 recommend (that) we eat 省略 that，we eat 是宾语从句；at the end of the passage 是位置状语， 结构无陷阱。 55. What does the author recommend we eat at the end of the passage? A) Naturally produced foods. B) Processed protein substitutes. C) Red meats like traditional beef. D) New generations of alternate meat.

【定位】These new generations of alternate meat get all the attention, but don't forget about whole grains and vegetables. Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute. They're nutritious, inexpensive, and far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes on the market today. 这些新一代的肉类替代品备受关注，但不要忘了全谷物和蔬菜。豆类是格外出色的蛋白替代 品。它们营养丰富、价格便宜，可持续性远胜于今天市面上任何加工过的植物肉替代品。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 whole grains and vegetables ↔Naturally produced foods far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes ↔ Naturally produced foods 预判要「天然食物」，Naturally produced foods 同时覆盖三类推荐对象的共同属性， 是唯一合适项。 B) 与原文相反 Processed protein substitutes 说的正是作者要反对的加工蛋白替代品，far more sustainable than any of the processed meatless substitutes 明确把这类产品当对 照面。 C) 与原文相反 Red meats like traditional beef 是全文反复劝退的对象（red meat been linked to cancer），作者绝不会在结尾推荐它。 D) 与原文相反 New generations of alternate meat 与 These new generations of alternate meat 原词复现，但原文用 but 转折表示「它们抢了风头但作者另有所荐」，并非推荐对象。
